# Third-party source placement

The complete modified Rockbox source tree is included in the sibling `rockbox/`
directory for corresponding-source compliance.

Source snapshot:

- upstream: `https://github.com/Rockbox/rockbox.git`
- commit: `fd8d6f10a1581492619a765a5cb9eead20314e3b`
- local modified files: see [`../docs/fork-audit.md`](../docs/fork-audit.md)

Do not replace this with an unpinned URL, a shallow working directory, or only
the generated firmware image. This tracked release contains the complete
matching Rockbox source and its retained `docs/`, `fonts/`, and `wps/` notices.
